NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2219-21 West Cermak Road
From B3-2 to B2-5

The Property
The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

It is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location approximately 1,296’ from the Damen Pink Line CTA station
entrance.

The Project
PINK LINE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “Applicant”) proposes to build a five story mixed

use building (57°-2” height) with ground floor commercial space (1,200 square feet), 16 units and four indoor
parking spaces. 16 bicycle spaces will be provided.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from
a B3-2 Community Shopping District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A for
relief under section 17-13-1003-EE(1) to allow a decrease in parking for properties in a Transit Served Location
to a qualifying train station from 8 required parking spaces (50%) under section 17-3-0308 to 4 spaces; 2) an
optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required 30’ rear yard setback required under section
17-3-0405-A to 5.0’.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 4,800 square feet

FAR: 4.0

Floor Area: 19,200 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 16

MLA Density: 300.0 square feet

Height: 57-2”

Bicycle Parking: 16

Automobile Parking: 4*

Setbacks: Front (north/Cermak): 4.0”
East: 12.0”
West: 12.0”

Rear (south/alley): 5.0°*

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
